instructions: Draw the long diagonal down to the right.
Sweep the upper-right arm down to the diagonal.
Curve the lower-left leg down.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the right side down to the baseline.
Draw the base from right to left.
Draw the stem down with its small top and foot.
Add the lower-left leg.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the right leg down, under the roof.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Bring the right side down.
Add the short left leg. Leave the gap above it.
Draw the small top, then straight down.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the stem down from the roof.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the right leg down.
Draw the left leg down, connected to the roof.
From the upper left, curve down, around, and into the top curl.
Draw a small top and a short downstroke. Keep it short.
Curve across the top, down the right, and left along the base.
Start above the roof and curve into the top bar.
Sweep down from the right to the baseline.
Draw the left slant, then continue down the left leg.
From the join, arch up and around to the lower opening.
Draw the top, down the stem, and left along the foot.
Curve down and around, then close the shape across the top.
Sweep the right stem down and left along the foot.
Add the left slant down to the join.
Start at the inner tongue, curve up and around, then finish left.
Draw the long diagonal down to the right.
Bring the upper-right arm down to the join.
Draw the base from right to left.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the right sweep down toward the baseline.
Add the separate left leg below the baseline.
Curve along the roof and down the right side.
Sweep the right arm down and around toward the lower left.
Draw the left arm down to meet the base.
Curve the middle arm down to the left join.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Draw the right leg down.
Draw the left leg down and finish with its little foot.
Curve across the top, then down below the baseline.
Draw the roof from right to left.
Continue down the right and left along the base.
Close the shape with the left side.
Draw the small top and continue below the baseline.
Start at the inner tongue, curve up and around, then down.
Draw the long slant down below the baseline.
Bring the upper-right arm down to the join.
